units.source_text: ……但是，黑暗的力量又立即复苏，把我从那里带了出来。

en.t: ...But the power of darkness immediately revived again and drew me out of that place.

units.source_text: 我还是一定要把金阁烧掉。

en.t: I still had to burn down the Golden Pavilion.

units.source_text: 到了那个时候，特别定造的、我特别制造的、前所未闻的生命就将开始。

en.t: When that time came, a life specially made to order, specially fashioned by me, and unheard of before would begin.
